title: Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Fee Schedule
content:
The figures below are the fee amounts set for each certificate of the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing, in USD.

| Certificate | Filing fee (new filing) | Refiling fee after rejection | Amended filing fee | Reinstatement filing fee | Release filing fee | Duplicate certificate fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate | 35.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | 35.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

State fees collected by Cardinal: **No**, on every certificate. State reinstatement or administrative fees are not collected by Cardinal.

## Column definitions

- **Filing fee:** the fee for a new filing.
- **Refiling fee after rejection:** the fee for transmitting a corrected filing after a state rejection.
- **Amended filing fee:** the fee for an amended filing.
- **Reinstatement filing fee:** the fee for a reinstatement filing after the policy is reinstated.
- **Release filing fee:** the fee for the release notice at the end of the requirement.
- **Duplicate certificate fee:** the fee for another copy of the certificate sent to the customer.

## Schedule notes

1. The two out-of-state SR-22 certificates carry the higher filing fee (35.00 against 25.00), an amended filing fee of 15.00 where the other certificates show 0.00, and a reinstatement filing fee of 25.00 where the other certificates show 15.00.
2. The refiling, release and duplicate certificate fees are 0.00 on all six certificates.
3. Owner and owner-operator versions of the same certificate family carry identical figures.
